# Tokenisation SDK Documentation

> The Stripe of Real-World Asset Tokenization. A comprehensive SDK for compliant tokenized asset platforms with built-in KYC, governance, and multi-chain support.

## Getting Started
- [Installation Guide](docs/getting-started/INSTALLATION.md) Prerequisites and step-by-step instructions for installing Node.js 18+ and SDK dependencies
- [Quick Start Guide](docs/getting-started/QUICKSTART.md) Minimal viable example to tokenize and transfer assets within minutes
- [First Project Tutorial](docs/getting-started/FIRST_PROJECT.md) Hands-on tutorial walking through real estate tokenization with practical code samples

## Core Concepts
- [Core Concepts](docs/CONCEPTS.md) Foundation explanations of asset tokenization, its importance, and SDK capabilities
- [Glossary](docs/GLOSSARY.md) 80+ technical terms and definitions used throughout the TokenisationSDK

- [Smart Contracts Reference](docs/api/CONTRACTS.md) ERC-3643 compliant smart contract specification

- [Authentication Guide](docs/AUTHENTICATION.md) Multi-language auth examples for JWT, API Key, and OAuth2
- [Error Reference](docs/ERROR_REFERENCE.md) Standardized error codes, response format, and troubleshooting

## Recipes (Use Cases with Chainlink)
- [Recipes Overview](docs/recipes/README.md) Index of 5 self-contained task-oriented guides for real-world use cases
- [Real Estate — Price Feeds](docs/recipes/01-real-estate.md) Tokenize real estate with live NAV from Chainlink price feeds
- [Airline Tickets — Automation](docs/recipes/02-airline-tickets.md) Tokenize airline tickets using Chainlink Automation upkeeps
- [Car Rental — CCIP Cross-Chain](docs/recipes/03-car-rental.md) Cross-chain settlement for car rental security deposits
- [Hotel Reservations — Compliance Mint](docs/recipes/04-hotel-tickets.md) Compliance-gated minting with hash-chained audit receipts
- [Concert Tickets — Proof of Reserve](docs/recipes/05-concert-tickets.md) Proof of Reserve to prevent minting beyond venue capacity
